name: Fey Tormentor
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Fey Pact Feat)) You gain the following benefits. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest. When you reach character level 5, you also have the Bestow Curse spell prepared and can cast it in the same way.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Faerie Time Warp
features.description: As a Bonus Action, choose up to three creatures you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it takes a −2 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Hag’s Hex
features.description: You always have the Hex spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have. The spell’s spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.
